closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin K, fibre, and omega 3, but the biggest weaknesses are low protein quality, low potassium, and freshness and prep can matter. It is good for immune support, digestion, and low-calorie volume because vitamin C and vitamin A help the immune-support part, fibre supports digestion and steadier meals, and it can make a meal feel bigger without adding many calories.
